Raw-value eq assertions fail under any downcase/get_created_via-style mapping; nil assertions fail under || {} / || '' fabrication (rule 13 defects) AND under wrongful existing-user assignment because the guarding POSTs send real values; the have_received keyword expectation fails under a positional signature or a symbol-key session read (seeded keys are strings); exact-string redirect assertions fail if D19's bare URL regains params. notes: Zero findings after from-scratch verification of all five files against production code at HEAD fc3f047f9. Prior finding l1-run4-001 verified resolved: the amendment is present and consistent at all three sites — §5.1 rule 2 ('.slice(0, 255), then drop a trailing lone high surrogate (code unit 0xD800–0xDBFF)... 254 code units in that case'), §7 constraint 1 ('surrogate-safe truncation to 255 code units per value (254 when the slice would split a surrogate pair)'), §11 note 4 ('the 255-code-unit surrogate-safe cap (5.1 rule 2)') — and matches the shipped sanitizeTrackingValue (utils.js: slice(0, 255) then drop trailing code unit in 0xD800–0xDBFF). One nuance checked and judged non-divergent: the shipped drop is unconditional on any trailing high surrogate (including one already terminal in a short input, not slice-created); §5.1's own invariant sentence 'A value must never end in an unpaired surrogate' describes exactly that behavior, so the amended text covers the code. My area (§9) is otherwise untouched by the amendment; §9's Jest paragraph is unaffected. Settled rulings respected: M2's dormant connect-branch nil crash is routed around by login_intent: 'hire' (as §9 item 1 mandates), not re-flagged; utils.test.js absence not flagged (KNOWN BASELINES). One neutral observation, not a finding: the organizations spec stubs set_sentry_context in addition to the §9-required three stubs — additive to the ai-credit pattern and harmless with a real User as current_user.
